XR expert for press

Need an XR expert on deadline?

Morten Haulik is a Copenhagen-based XR expert available for comment on virtual reality, augmented reality, mixed reality and smart glasses. As a founder who builds XR products himself, he can explain what a new device or announcement actually means, in plain language, in English or Danish.

  • Meta Quest headsets and Meta’s smart glasses
  • Apple Vision Pro and visionOS
  • Google, Samsung and Android XR
  • Smart glasses, privacy and cameras on our faces
  • The metaverse: what is hype and what is real

  • WebXR and the open web versus app stores

Previous coverage

Morten has appeared on Berlingske’s podcast Pilestræde analysing Apple Vision Pro, on Radio4’s Kulturmagasinet with Christiane Vejlø, behind the scenes at DR2’s So ein Ding with Nikolaj Sonne, and in coverage from Voice of America, The Copenhagen Post, CBS Wire and 24Victoria. His work with MidwifeVR was covered in depth by Berlingske.

How to reach me fast

Email Morten@nxtwebxr.com with your outlet, angle and deadline. Morten is available for quotes, background briefings, phone and video interviews, and studio appearances in Copenhagen, in Danish or English. High-resolution press photos can be downloaded below.

Frequently asked

Can I quote Morten on new VR headsets or smart glasses?

Yes. Morten regularly comments on new devices from Meta, Apple, Google and Samsung, and can explain what they mean for consumers, businesses and developers.

Is Morten available for live radio or TV?

Yes, in Danish or English, in studio in Copenhagen or remotely.
